G_S: (L_stale - L_fresh), positive means stale costs more; percentages of C_ref
description: JSON; all numerical thresholds must be explicitly supplied by the author/orchestrator.

horizon_rule.all: one regime x tau unit; all specified horizons (and both sides for regret) must pass
horizon_rule.each: one regime x tau x horizon unit; both sides for regret must pass

onset: off unless --onset-theta is supplied; truth theta must equal card onset_theta
ties: exact primary objective ties before tie-break; rhat tie variants flag the original M0 tie
